# opnsense_haproxy_frontend (Resource)

A HAProxy frontend (OPNsense: Public Service) without TLS. Settings not listed here keep their OPNsense defaults on create and their current values on update. This resource never reads or writes the frontend's rule list; manage that with `opnsense_haproxy_frontend_actions`, which in turn touches nothing else, so both can point at the same frontend. Requires the `os-haproxy` plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Plain HTTP frontend. Its rule list is set with opnsense_haproxy_frontend_actions.
# Binding port 80 on all addresses needs the web GUI's HTTP redirect disabled
# (System > Settings > Administration), which otherwise holds port 80.
resource "opnsense_haproxy_frontend" "http" {
  name            = "http-80"
  bind            = ["0.0.0.0:80"]
  default_backend = opnsense_haproxy_backend.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bind` (Set of String) Listen addresses as `address:port`, e.g. `0.0.0.0:80` or `[::]:80`.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this frontend. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` only.

### Optional

- `default_backend` (String) UUID of the backend pool (`opnsense_haproxy_backend`) that receives requests no rule matched. Empty means none. Defaults to `""`.
- `description` (String) Description for this frontend. Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this frontend. Defaults to `true`.
- `mode` (String) `http` (layer 7) or `tcp` (layer 4). The `ssl` mode is not supported because its certificate settings are not modelled. Defaults to `http`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the frontend.
